image_description: A close-up photograph of a pale yellow to cream-colored coral fungus (likely Ramaria or Clavulina species) growing on dark, decaying wood or forest floor debris. The fungus exhibits a complex, multi-branched structure with numerous upright, cylindrical branches that divide into finer tips. The background consists of blurred dark organic matter and small green moss patches.
